name: pulse-refactor-safety
description: Safely refactors React components in this Laravel app without changing behaviour. Use when extracting hooks, splitting components, renaming props, simplifying state, reducing duplication, preserving public APIs, or improving maintainability.
purpose: Keep refactors surgical, verifiable, and respectful of existing consumers.
single_responsibility: Refactor React components without changing observable behaviour or public API unless an API migration is approved.
triggers: Refactoring component internals or extracting hooks, helpers, or subcomponents
Reducing duplication or simplifying state without changing behaviour
Changing or preserving a public component API
completion_criteria: Externally visible behaviour and consumers are identified before changes
Refactor is sequenced in small steps that preserve public API and behaviour
Tests or verification cover affected behaviour before and after
validation_criteria: Behaviour remains unchanged or changes are documented
Maintainability improved for a concrete reason
failure_handling: If a refactor cannot preserve behaviour or public API, stop and surface the required change instead of silently altering consumers.
Report any unavoidable behaviour or API changes and their consumer impact.
escalation_path: Route public API changes back to pulse-api-contract before editing consumers.
Route uncertain framework or library behaviour through pulse-docs-research.
Escalate broad architectural rewrites to pulse-architecture-boundaries or the user.
responsibilities: Identify behaviour that must remain unchanged.
Preserve public API unless an API migration is approved.
Ensure tests or verification cover affected behaviour.
Preserve hydration, accessibility, and native gesture behaviour unless the refactor explicitly targets them.
